select distinct A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, A.FINPROD_ABBR text, A.FINPROD_ID object, decode(D.OPEN_TYPE, #{openPlanType03}, #{openPlanType03}, #{openPlanType01}) col from FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ PMO ON PMO.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY PPA ON PMO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PPA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PPA.USER_ID = #{userId}, FIN_CASH_INFO C, FIN_OPEN_RULE D where A.OPERATION_TYPE = #{openType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND C.CASH_ID = D.CASH_ID AND D.OPEN_MODE != #{openMode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR A.FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))

select distinct row_number() over(order by FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID) NUM, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.PROFIT_TYPE, FOP.OPEN_DATE_STR, FOP.OPEN_DATE_END, FOP.OPEN_VDATE, FOP.OPEN_MDATE, FOP.OPEN_NDATE, FOP.OPEN_TYPE,
FP.FINPROD_ID
from FIN_PRODUCT FP INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ PMO ON PMO.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY PPA ON PMO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PPA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PPA.USER_ID = #{userId}, FIN_OPEN_PLAN FOP where FP.FINPROD_ID = FOP.FINPROD_ID
AND FOP.FINPROD_ID IN
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FOP.OPEN_TYPE = decode(FOP.OPEN_TYPE, #{openPlanType03}, #{openPlanType03}, #{scheduleType})
AND FOP.OPEN_DATE_STR between #{openDateStrStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{openDateStrEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
order by FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, FOP.OPEN_DATE_STR ASC
